evidence.finding: Current Charge-in estate exposes 5 French locations / 13 charge points through Monta-hosted inventory; observed direct/ad-hoc station prices are heterogeneous (e.g. 0.25 EUR/kWh Provins, 0.30 AC and 0.48 HPC Orchies, 0.44 AC Sarlat).
Monta is the supervision/payment platform; price observations must not be promoted as a universal Charge-in tariff and historical 3-station/4-PDC estate no longer matches current footprint.

decision: active->setAside; authority is resolved but estate changed and tariff is station/connector-specific. No universal CPO-direct tariff. Exact current Monta/QR tariff may be used only when station/EVSE mapping is deterministic; otherwise fallback.
tariffPolicy: No eMSP tariff inheritance. Monta-hosted station tariff is acceptable only as exact ad-hoc station/EVSE evidence, not network extrapolation. Fallback Electra then Electroverse.
